candidates.title: France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program (Eiffel Excellence Scholarship)
candidates.official_source: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (managed by Campus France)
candidates.deadline_display: 2026 campaign (now closed): call opened October 1, 2025; deadline for reception of applications by Campus France 'January 8, 2026 included'; results published 'from the 30th of March, 2026'. No 2027 campaign window/deadline is stated on the page as of 2026-10-12.
candidates.description: The France Excellence Eiffel scholarship programme was established by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs so that French higher education institutions can attract top foreign students to their master's and PhD programmes. The page states it targets future foreign decision-makers of the private and public sectors in priority areas of study, and encourages applicants from foreign countries up to 29 years old at master's level and up to 35 years old at PhD level. Students cannot apply directly: the page states 'Only applications submitted by French higher education institutions are accepted.' Institutions that have already participated receive file-access details by email, or contact candidatures.eiffel@campusfrance.org; first-time institutions must contact the same address to obtain the application files. Student applicants are pointed to the Campus France student information page (https://www.campusfrance.org/en/node/303563) instead of an application form. 2026 Campaign Timeline as published: opening October 1, 2025; deadline for reception of applications by Campus France January 8, 2026 included; results published from March 30, 2026. As of 2026-10-12 the stated 2026 application window has closed and the page still carries the banner 'Call for application 2026 is open' but publishes no 2027 dates, so the current/upcoming status is assessed as not_open_yet. This overview page does NOT state: the monthly allowance amount in EUR, the duration, what the allowance covers (including whether tuition is covered), countries excluded, or English-language requirements; those details sit in the linked 'France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship - Implementation' article and the Eiffel programme plaquettes (PDF, marked 'Mise à jour December 2025'), which were not fetched because only the URLs specified for this task were authorized. The article itself carries no 'Last updated' date; the related plaquette resources are marked 'Mise à jour December 2025'.
eligibility: Foreign (international) students enrolling in master's programmes at French higher education institutions
Foreign (international) students enrolling in PhD programmes at French higher education institutions
Master's level: applicants from foreign countries up to 29 years old
PhD level: applicants from foreign countries up to 35 years old
candidates.eligibility_summary: International students enrolling in French higher education institutions' master's and PhD programmes, up to 29 years old at master's level and up to 35 years old at PhD level. Applications must be submitted by the French institution; direct student applications are not accepted.
application_method: Applications are submitted by French higher education institutions only - the page states: 'Only applications submitted by French higher education institutions are accepted.'

Institutions already participating in the Eiffel programme should have received an email with access to the application files; if not, contact candidatures.eiffel@campusfrance.org (Campus France - Programme France Excellence Eiffel, 28 rue de la Grange-aux-Belles, 75010 Paris)
Institutions participating for the first time must contact candidatures.eiffel@campusfrance.org to download the application files

Students interested in the programme are directed to the Campus France student information page (https://www.campusfrance.org/en/node/303563); no direct student application form is offered on the page
candidates.selection_notes: Applications are received by Campus France and evaluated for the campaign; the page announces 'Publication of results: from the 30th of March, 2026' for the 2026 session. Programme rules for the 2026 session are published as 'Eiffel Programme rules - 2026 Session' linked from the page. The page does not publish selection committee details, stipend amounts, or exclusions of specific countries.

evidence.quote: The Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Program was established by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs to enable French higher education institutions to attract top foreign students to enroll in their masters and PhD programs.

It gives opportunity to the future foreign decision-makers of the private and public sectors, in priority areas of study, and encourages applicants from foreign countries up to 29 years old at master's level, and applicants up to 35 years old at PhD level.
Only applications submitted by French higher education institutions are accepted.
2026 Campaign Timeline - Opening of the call for applications: October 1, 2025
Deadline for the reception of applications by Campus France: January 8, 2026 included.
Publication of results: from the 30th of March, 2026
